notes: Built 1927 as Julius Meier's summer estate (Meier was Oregon's governor 1931-35; Herbert Hoover visited). Now run by First Presbyterian Church of Portland, but rented to secular groups; about 200 groups a year. Rates are not published — everything goes through a group inquiry form. Office (503) 695-2243, office@menucha.org, Mon-Fri 8-4.
